Container.Name: XKNX-Editor
Container.Overview:
XKNX Editor in your browser: open, edit and export KNX projects (.knxproj), browse the product catalog and program KNX devices over a KNXnet/IP interface. It is the same editor as the desktop app, drawn by the browser itself.
Open the Web UI and sign in with the password set below. Projects you open and save, exported .knxproj files and other files go to the Projects folder; the app settings and the imported product catalog stay in the App Data folder.
KNX bus access: tunnelling to an interface by its IP address works with the default Bridge network. Gateway discovery and KNX routing use multicast, which only reaches the container with the Host network type.
Signed exports (optional): exporting a project that other tools accept as signed needs a key extracted from an installation of the KNX authoring tool you own; the key is never shipped. In the editor, open Signing and upload Knx.Ets.XmlSigning.dll with its sibling assemblies, or copy them into the Projects folder and pick them there.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: KNX knxproj xknx knxprod building automation

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port of the web UI on the server.

Config.Name: Web Password
Config.Description: Password every browser signs in with. The web UI is reachable from the whole network and can program the installation, so choose a strong one.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: App settings, the imported product catalog, the product data cache and the logs.

Config.Name: Projects
Config.Description: The folder the editor opens and saves files in: projects, exported .knxproj files and assemblies for signing-key extraction. Point it to a share to reach the files from other computers.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the editor runs as, so the files it saves belong to this user (99 is Unraid's nobody). 0 runs it as root.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the editor runs as (100 is Unraid's users).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Permissions of new files; 000 lets every user of the shares change them.
